items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Then with Benny Carter, the Chocolate Dandy series, and, you know, Chu, and Ben Webster did some of those.

ctx.x: Oh, I did quite a few of those small band records. Then with Benny Carter, the Chocolate Dandy series, and, you know, Chu, and Ben Webster did some of those. The interesting thing, you know the Chocolate Dandies was supposed to be like an all Negro group, the chocolate color, dandy is sort of a citified slicker, well dressed, sharp guy.
